free_resources.title: Working Through Anxiety
free_resources.description: A 14-minute guided meditation and visualization set to original music, designed to help listeners move through anxiety and fear by connecting with a sense of divine support. It's well suited for coaches, teachers, or anyone seeking a calming tool they can also share with clients or students. It streams free on Insight Timer with no subscription required.
